profileJudgments.reasonedJudgment: The unchanged DE/EN whole goal asks for criteria-based daily/nutritional carbohydrate evaluation. Its two retained whole cases and expectations are exactly the original first two:10g/100mL×200mL=20g versus5g/100mL×500mL=25g, followed by sucrose sweetness versus starch consistency and a bounded judgement. No industrial process or site-choice duty remains on this SekI goal. The removed process, three-perspective comparison and fresh water-loop duty survive in the separate new d786a03c profile/material, so this is reassignment rather than deletion.

profileJudgments.wholeGoalTitleDe: Fette über Struktur und Eigenschaften erklären
profileJudgments.wholeGoalTitleEn: Explain fats through structure and properties
profileJudgments.reasonedJudgment: The unchanged whole goal is explicitly physical structure/property reasoning. The retained whole cases correctly construct a discrete triester, distinguish it from a polymer, compare equal-length saturated/cis residues through packing, and transfer to equal-unsaturation cis/trans samples and water/nonpolar-solvent behaviour. Supplied synthetic melting ranges make C liquid and D solid at20°C; natural mixture/crystal/temperature limits prevent a universal ranking. The first two original cases and expectations remain exact. Separate quantitative indices, oxidative durability inference and catalytic reaction duties are preserved in the new goals rather than silently retained as physical-goal graduation conditions.

profileJudgments.wholeGoalTitleEn: Evaluate industrial sugar production using its process
profileJudgments.reasonedJudgment: The whole new DE/EN competence coherently links one supplied beet-sugar process to a conditional production decision. Hot-water extraction, lime/carbonation, CaCO3 precipitation and filtration, evaporation, crystallisation and centrifugation are chemically consistent; filtration is not said to remove all dissolved impurities. A/B use the same1t food-suitable output and cultivation-to-gate boundary. Emissions240/180±30kgCO2e, water12/20m3, cost430/390EUR, jobs/evidence and land are separate criteria; absent social documentation is not proof of abuse. Fresh C changes A water to7m3 and cost to450EUR, preserving emissions; it can change a locally water-weighted decision without establishing a complete LCA. Operative material0 withholds C and rubrics until the own baseline response. One integrated judgement with genuinely new conditions can supply the evidence; no extra task quota.

profileJudgments.wholeGoalTitleEn: Interpret fat indices through molecular structure
profileJudgments.reasonedJudgment: The full quantitative and interpretation cases support the whole DE/EN fat-index competence. For ideal pure triesters, SV=3×56.1×1000/M gives190.17,188.89,263.38mgKOH/g for A/B/C. IV=n(C=C)×253.8×100/M gives86.03gI2/100g for A and0 for B/C. A/C equal mass mixture D therefore gives226.78mgKOH/g and43.02gI2/100g; mass weighting, not molecule weighting, is correct. U/S/K and U1/U2,X,Y force bounded composition/oxidation conclusions and distinguish free-acid consumption, packaging/light/temperature and unknown cis/trans from an expiry date or unique molecule. The two related source duties form one assessable index-interpretation competence. Operative materials1/2 withhold D and the changed-condition cards; the historic complete strings remain archived. No experiment is fabricated and no direct iodine student method is prescribed.

profileJudgments.wholeGoalTitleEn: Explain fat hardening as catalytic addition
profileJudgments.reasonedJudgment: The whole new DE/EN goal is catalytic addition to a defined fat, with the ester framework retained. Three alkene groups use3molH2 per mol triacylglycerol; each carbon gains H and no small product is eliminated. The catalyst is above the arrow and not a stoichiometric reactant. The comparison with ester cleavage and ionic HX addition prevents a false carbocation mechanism being imported into surface hydrogenation. Fresh Q starts with6C=C and reacts3, consuming3H2 and retaining3C=C; lower IV does not give an exact new value without molar mass, and possible trans isomerisation is not made a compulsory product or a health verdict. Packing/consistency inference is conditional for model equal-length cis residues and is within the reaction competence. Material3 explicitly withholds Q until the baseline response and is a paper model.

The unchanged whole DE/EN goal concerns delocalisation, allowed transitions and an energy scheme. The whole profile retains500nm from2.48eV, about300nm from4.13eV,620/400nm for2.00/3.10eV and the distinction between removed light and transmitted colour. The replacement material locates the band-specific chromophore, computes350nm→3.54eV and500nm→2.48eV, explains the supplied500→410nm protonation shift and retains the sp3/330nm coupling-break transfer. It no longer adds historical auxochrome/antiauxochrome naming or colourant-family classification to this competence. The underlying energy/coupling explanations and limits are sound. Its former historical term duty is present in64b content, but the claimed preservation across HB views is blocked separately by A-V3-TERM-ROUTE-01.

profileJudgments.wholeGoalTitleEn: Explain substituent effects in dye molecules
profileJudgments.reasonedJudgment: The complete unchanged DE/EN competence is substituent donor/acceptor influence on a coupled dye. Existing510→430nm amino protonation and500→330nm sp3 interruption cases remain, with lone-pair donation, nitro withdrawal and no universal colour/shift rule. The expanded third case and complete material5 genuinely require all three historical HB names, band-specific chromophore localisation, calculations350/500nm, protonation and new broken coupling. These are coherent aspects of this whole competence; no dye-family classification routine is imported. IUPAC primary terminology independently confirms that auxochrome is obsolete, so retaining it explicitly as a historical curriculum convention with overlapping roles is sound. However the proposed goal is LK-tagged and absent from all four HB views while the term assignment claims GK_LK. Content acceptance is therefore not acceptance of its HB delivery/source route.

profileJudgments.wholeGoalTitleDe: Chemische Anwendungen und ihre gesellschaftliche Bedeutung diskutieren
profileJudgments.wholeGoalTitleEn: Discuss chemical applications and their social significance
profileJudgments.reasonedJudgment: The whole unchanged DE/EN goal covers concrete chemical functions and justified social/human/environmental discussion. The supplied four full bilingual cards now make flocculation/settling/filtration, coating-mediated corrosion protection, polymer barrier function and battery electrode/electron/ion coupling available as givens. Their model solutions require linking functions to benefits, residues/resources and evidence limits; they do not infer drinking-water safety, product migration approval, a complete LCA or battery clearance. Fresh industrial-compost and opposing-permeability cards are delivered subsequently, preventing a universal polymer/degradability rule. Whole retained HB lower-secondary CO/CO2 and cleaner-dose cases were also inspected: these are correctly source scoped, preserve environment AND health pathways or equal-function6/18mL dosing, and use changed claims/soiling without extra experiment duties. Supplied knowledge still must be applied independently; it is not learner performance.

The unchanged nationwide DE/EN goal is method-neutral formula conversion with sufficient structure information. Its ethanol/dimethyl-ether and fresh ethene core cases remain exact. Every changed HB-specific performance, understanding, case and variation field now carries an explicit HB/SekII/GK-LK/authored-topic2.1 guard and all four exact view IDs; CrossStage applies only to its SekII part. Outside or unresolved scope it neither adds a universal core completion duty nor grants source completion. Actual primary PDF26 requires physical kits AND digital3D conversion, so keeping both own actions/products and leaving missing tools unfulfilled is faithful. The full open-chain data correctly preserve glucoseRLRR, mannoseLLRR as OH-side patterns, only C2 different, local Fischer depth, valence and stereochemistry under rotation. Neither a supplied screenshot nor our review counts as tool execution. Scope text is accepted as candidate coach/evidence semantics; actual compiled enforcement and final native binding are later gates.

The whole DE/EN competence and all four understanding expectations remain unchanged. The actual original two complete case cards now explicitly say20kgPE TOTAL for1000 equivalent bags per route, fixing the ambiguity without altering any emission, land, water, chemistry or rubric model. Per bag this is20gPE, fossil30gCO2e/0.1L and bio20gCO2e/0.5L/0.04m2year; bio origin does not imply degradation. Reuse200/n+c gives20/12g at20uses and50/42g at5uses; break-even X20uses and Yceil(100/9)=12, while90% collection is not recycling yield. The later electricity/reuse case is explicitly held until initial work. The unchanged whole microplastic card was also inspected:equal1.2g abrasion at equal polymer/function, primary/secondary and dissolved/mineral exclusions under a stated<5mm working definition, plus a different-polymer/collection fresh case that forbids carrying over the old equality. No energy value, actual measurement or complete sustainability judgement is invented.
